title: headcount-sync-hiring-prep-scratchpad-maya
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for the weekly headcount sync (Fri 10am PT). Focus: prioritize open reqs, interview loop capacity, upcoming offers, and org planning asks for Q2.

Agenda bullets (30m total):
- Quick status (5m): pipeline + open reqs by priority
- Interview bandwidth (8m): who is overloaded, backfill schedule, interview pairing adjustments
- Offers & comp (7m): pending approvals, salary bands, sign-on considerations for senior ICs
- Org asks & tradeoffs (7m): new manager reqs vs IC hiring, headcount ramp timeline for Dedicated infra team
- Action items & next steps (3m)

Notes / snapshot:
- Hiring pipeline:
  - Backend Engineer (Dedicated runtime) - 3 onsites scheduled next week (approx hiring band 5). Top candidate (C-1) strong on serving runtime, flagged for manager interview.
  - Infra SRE (Platform) - 2 candidates in loop, one withdrew (relocation). Need to re-open pipeline if no additional slate this sprint.
  - Applied ML Engineer (Quantization) - early pipeline, we should consider pulling from contractor pool for short-term support.

- Capacity constraints:
  - Eng leads report interview fatigue; avg interviews per week per interviewer = 6 (target <=4). Ava and Ryan flagged as critical blockers for next-week loops.
  - Propose shifting some loops to senior ICs in other squads and adding one more pre-screen (recruiter screen + hiring manager 30m) to reduce total interviewer minutes.

- Compensation notes:
  - Backend Engineer target band: $180k-$210k base (US-SF). Hiring manager prefers to reserve top of band for remote senior candidates.
  - Manager hire for Dedicated infra: did not get approval in last budget pass; need to surface in org ask with clear ROI (latency/cost savings forecast).

Candidate-specific quick notes (for debriefs):
- C-1 (BE) - wrote strong infra design for KV cache invalidation, 4 yrs infra at mid-size scale, expected comp at top of band, references due by Tue. Interview notes: excellent system design, weaker on team signals (leadership examples).
- C-2 (SRE) - good on chaos testing and monitoring, limited experience with GPU infra, may be better as IC2 level.
- C-3 (AML) - strong research background, needs pairing with applied infra engineer to ensure productization.

Open questions to raise in sync:
- Can recruiting allocate 2 additional sourcers for infra roles through end of Q2? (cost ~2 FTE equivalent)
- Are we comfortable delaying the Dedicated infra manager hire until H2 if we commit to 2 senior ICs now?
- Do we have budget headroom to increase signing bonuses for high-competition roles?

Proposed asks (to present):
- Short-term: approve 2-week surge sourcing for infra reqs (Ava to confirm cost estimate).
- Medium-term: reclassify 1 open senior IC req to a manager req only if we get clear commit from product that roadmap scope increases by 25%.
- Interview process tweak: add one 30m standardized technical screen by recruiting to reduce scheduling burden and improve slate quality.

Debrief action items (assignments):
- Maya: compile candidate feedback templates and send to hiring managers by EOD Fri (owner: Maya) [due: 2026-03-01].
- Ava: get cost estimate for surge sourcers and confirm availability (owner: Ava) [due: 2026-03-03].
- Ryan: adjust interviewer rotation for next-week loops and confirm 2 backup interviewers (owner: Ryan) [due: 2026-03-02].
- Jordan: escalate Dedicated infra manager ask to VP Eng with draft ROI paragraph (owner: Jordan) [due: 2026-03-04].

Notes-to-self / talking points:
- Emphasize that delaying manager will increase time-to-delivery for key infra projects by ~6-8 weeks unless we add senior IC capacity.
- Flag candidate C-1 as priority for manager interview (good fit technically; need leadership validation).
- Keep tone collaborative with hiring managers — goal is to balance speed with interview quality.

Loose ends / follow-ups:
- Need final comp ranges for remote vs SF roles (People Ops to confirm).
- Confirm hack-day next month for interview calibrations (suggested date window: Apr 7-9).
- Pull latest attrition numbers for Platform team to include in next sync slide (linked_artifact JIRA-4521 may have related tickets).

Quick links:
- Headcount plan (Confluence): confluence:/HR/Headcount-Plan-2026
- Job reqs board: JIRA-4521
- Interview loop templates: gitlab.com/redwood/infrastructure/-/merge_requests/178

Scratchpad log:
- 2026-02-20: added C-1 note after mtg with hiring manager (Sam).
- 2026-02-25: flagged interviewer overload and proposed extra recruiter screen.
- 2026-02-28: finalized action item owners for next sync.

Tags for follow-up: #surge-sourcing #interviewer-rotation #comp-approval

End of notes.
